 From the Desk of Principal




Dear Students,
Greetings from Golaghat Purbanchalik College.It is an
Institution with a long tradition of creativity,charisma and charm. Established in 1987, the college has
evolved in to a glorious institution during its journey of thirty eight years with the best academic and
learning atmosphere. In this process, it has accomplished many significant milestones in the field of
higher education in this part of our district as well as our state with yet to be achieved more. It is best time
to lift the institution to newer heights of excellence by leveraging the contemporary paradigms and
discourses of Higher Education in the field of Humanity and Social Sciences. We have been constantly
striving to provide quality education that would nurture knowledge, skill and attitude in individuals
through a curriculum responsive to the changing socio-economic and cultural realities. Our effort is to
realize the motto "Quest for Excellence" with an approach to address in a pragmatic way the educational
needs of a large section of society. The achievement that the college has acquired over the past few years
was the establishment of Golaghat Purbanchalik College Study Centers under KKHSOU. Additionally,
Four Years Undergraduate Program (FYUGP) under NEP 2020 has been introduced in the curriculum of
the institution which aims at enhancing the creative potential of the students. Moreover, conducting
Webinars and other academic activities by our efforts has been regular feature with success. These
achievements of the college have been credited to the team work of the competent faculty and staff with
cooperation, constant support, and expertise of all the stakeholders. We feel proud to be a part of it.
I, therefore, taking this opportunity, I extend a warm welcome to stakeholders of Golaghat Purbanchalik
College to accompany us in the long voyage towards the heights of excellence.

With best wishes,

Dr. Haren Hazarika
Principal
Golaghat Purbanchalik College




Golaghat Purbanchalik College Prospectus- 2025-2026                                                Page.2
 THE COLLEGE
Golaghat Purbanchalik College was established in 1987 at Hatiyekhowa, a rural place of
Golaghat District. A few social workers actively pursued the idea of establishing a College at the
centre of this area to serve the purpose of higher education since the year 1974. The first public
meeting was arranged at Molia Gaon L P School comprising a group of people from Dhekial
Mauza, Gurjogonia Mauza, Kakodonga Mauza and Dakhingera Mauza on 21st
December,1974.Let Tulsi Nath Borgohain then the Headmaster of Dhekial High School was the
president of that public meeting. After a few meetings held consecutively in different places of
the locality on this occasion, the decision was taken and proposed the name of the college as
‘Golaghat Purbanchalik College’. The ideal location was selected in the grazing land of
Gurjogonia Mauza near Hatiyekhowa Chariali (crossroads) with a view to spread higher
education of humanities among the masses. The foundation stone was laid on 15th September
1987, and the Governing Body was formed for administering the college. Many people took part
in the inaugural ceremony on that day. B.A. classes were started in the same year.

Since then, the college has been marching along with time and able to meet the aspirations over
the years of the people of the locality, the district as well as the state of Assam. It has been
playing a key role in socio-economic development of the society. Now, it becomes a foremost
institution of the state providing an excellent opportunity to interact among students coming
from different places irrespective of ethnic groups and linguistic background. To prepare for the
students to cope up with the challenges of modern society and to inculcate them with the spirit of
leadership in different avenues have all along been the guiding principles of the college. Over the
years, the college has been maintaining a fairly good record of performance in University
Examinations. The products of the college are now holding many responsible positions of the
society.

Presently the college comprises 7 departments of Arts disciplines. The college has well-equipped
library with wireless internet connectivity and e-journal browsing facility. In addition, each
department has its own library from which books are regularly issued to the students. The other
special features of the college are- a gymnasium with various facilities and a canteen. Moreover,
an education laboratory is available for practical classes. The college offers regular U.G. courses
under Dibrugarh University in the departments of Assamese, Education, Economics, English,
Political Science, Sociology and History.         Bearing in mind, the necessity of a healthy
environment, the college was declared a tobacco-free zone. Yoga camps are organized by the
NSS wing in the college. Golaghat Purbanchalik College has been constantly executing in-
house plans to enhance the scope of its educational initiatives. The college has grown in course
of time in the last 38 years and nurtures a dream of becoming a Centre of Excellence.

 THE CAMPUS
Situated at the Hatiyekhowa Gaon the Golaghat Purbanchalik College campus is extremely
suitable, safe and congenial for students. It is located in an area surrounded by tea gardens and
local communities who are closely related with the institution. It is surrounded by boundary
walls by three sides and gate at all entrance. While entering the college premises it is mandatory
for the students to wear college uniform and to carry valid identity cards issued by the college.
Visitors are required to register their names and purpose of visit at the college gates to avoid
entry of any unscrupulous individual to the campus. The College Administration has installed
many closed circuit cameras to keep a constant vigilance on the campus and to ensure security of
the students. The infrastructural set up of the college is as given bellow:
Administrative Building
The Administrative Building includes the Principal's Chamber, Office, Teachers' Common Room
and some of the Academic Departments.

Library
This building contains a well-equipped Central Library with wireless internet connectivity and
e-journal browsing facility. In addition, each department has its own library from which books
are regularly issued to the students.
Canteen
The college has fully functional canteens which offer a variety of food and drink options at affordable
prices.

TEACHING-LEARNING PROCES
Education is the process of facilitating learning and the acquisition of knowledge. As such,
Golaghat Purbanchalik College strives to ensure that the teaching-learning process involves
assessing the learning needs, learning objectives, teaching learning strategies, implementation of
various methods and evaluation of the learning outcomes. The college believes that, teaching-
learning is possible and attainable by providing conductive learning environment to the students.
The teachers serve as the prime movers of the educational wheel, while the students are the key
participants in the learning process. Keeping this in view, attention is given to the planning and
organization of the subject matter, content and activities. The college believes that, teaching-
learning is possible and attainable by providing conductive learning environment to the students.
The teachers serve as the prime movers of the educational wheel, while the students are the key
participants in the learning process. Keeping this in view, attention is given to the planning and
organization of the subject matter, content and activities.

 ACADEMIC AND RESEARCH ACTIVITIES
Research and Publication Cell of Golaghat Purbanchalik College has a record of publications.
Research Papers are regularly published in reputed journals, edited books. Reference books are
published by teachers at the individual level as well in the dept level also. The cell has published
an edited volume “Cinta Silpa” in 2023.


Webinars
Webinars of regional and National level have been organized at Golaghat Purbanchalik College
for academic enhancement of both students and faculty members. The IQAC actively endeavors
to host such activities. All the Departments enhance the activities of IQAC.




LIBRARY
Golghat Purbanchalik College library was established in 1987- the establishment year of the
college. In the time of beginning it had a few books. Gradually, the collection of books as well as
the services have been improved. Ex-Students, faculty members, office staff of the college past
and present and well wishers have been donated lots of books to the library. Students, faculty
members and the staff have membership of the college library. The objectives of the college
library are to ensure easy and timely access to its resources. In order to meet the challenges of
the time and cope up with readers, new management procedures and information and
communication technologies (ICT) have been deployed. To promote reading habits among the
users the library committee has introduced the ‘Best Library User Prize’. The Library has over
2120 (Two thousand one hundred and twenty) books, some recent and back volumes of
Magazines, Journals and daily News Papers. The library installed ‘KOHA’ an Integrated Library
Management Software (ILMS) in June 2023 to handle management functions and provides
services to patrons. Considering the fact that majority of the users belong to economically
weaker families the library takes extra care to them. The library also organize orientation
programme and takes feedback from its users regularly.

 Life at Golaghat Purbanchalik College
Foundation Day: Each year, the college celebrates its Foundation Day on 15th September with
great enthusiasm. Students, teachers and employees of the college actively participate to make
the event a grand success. Daylong celebrations that mark the birth of this prestigious institution
comprise a numbers of programs. Some of them are talk by renowned personalities, cultural
function, and recognitions of meritorious students and felicitation of faculty members for their
achievements. Best Best Graduate Awards and Best Reader Award are also conferred on the
occasion of college foundation day.
Literary Activities:

College Week: College Week is an event that every student is eagerly waiting for. Each year,
students experience a week-long experience during the college week that comprises events as
diverse as debate, quiz, indoor and outdoor sports events, music and cultural show, recitation, so
on.

Students' Union: The College has a students' union under the name, Golaghat Purbanchalik
College Students' Union Society (GPCSU). Every student of the college is a member of this
union. The office bearers are elected annually by the students through direct election conducted
as per the guidelines laid down by the Supreme Court of India. The Students' Union organizes
Saraswati Puja, Freshers' Social, Annual College Week, Cultural Functions, Debates and Literary
Activities, Social Service Activities etc. The society publishes the College magazine, GPCIAN
annually, to which students and teachers contribute their creative writings.

 VARIOUS CELLS OF GOLAGHAT PURBANCHALIK COLLEGE
Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
Golaghat Purbanchalik College has an active Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) as per the
guidelines of The National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC). The IQAC plans,
guides and monitors Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Enhancement (QE) activities of the
college. The main task of the IQAC is to channelize the efforts and measures of the college
towards maintaining academic excellence and robust internal governance. IQAC initiate plan and
supervise various activities which are necessary to increase the quality of education. IQAC
promotes several activities such as seminars, workshops, symposia, conferences, panel
discussions and academic meetings.

Right to Information Cell/Committee
In compliance with the RTI Act 2005, the College has constituted the RTI Cell of which the
Principal is the First Appellate Authority. The aim of RTI is to promote transparency and
accountability in official matters.

Students’ Grievances Redressal Cell/Committee
 As suggested by University Grants Commission, New Delhi, the College has established a
Students’ Grievance Redressal Cell, to provide a mechanism for redressal of students' grievances
and ensure the transparency in admission, and prevention of unfair practices, etc. The function of
the cell is to look into the complaints lodged by any student, and judge its merit. The cell is also
empowered to look into matters of harassment. Anyone with a genuine grievance may approach
the cell. In case the person is unwilling to appear in self, grievances may be sent through e-mail
to the Principal or to the co-ordinator of the cell.

Anti-Ragging Committee
As per judgments and directions of the Supreme Court of India, UGC guidelines and State
Government’s Instructions, Golaghat Purbanchalik College is following ‘Zero-Tolerance Policy’
towards ragging. To prevent any kind of such incident, the College has constituted an Anti-
Ragging Committee which is continuously monitoring the students. Any student of Golaghat
Purbanchalik College accused of and found guilty of ragging, will be severely dealt with, in
accordance with the Provisions of the Law. Any student who faces any kind of ragging incident is
hereby asked to report to the Principal immediately. For more details about Anti-Ragging Policy visit the
Website Page.

NSS (National Service Scheme)
The National Service Scheme (NSS) unit of Golaghat Purbanchalik College is rendering
commendable work by encouraging students to cherish dignity of labour and reverence for the
composite Indian Culture through its regular Personality Development Programmes and other
special camping activities.

 Career Guidance and Placement Cell (CGPC)
The college has set up a Career Guidance and Placement Cell to provide information and to
organize programmes highlighting career opportunities in different fields. It also organizes
Career Counseling Programmes in which students can learn job fields and get job opportunities
during their stay in the college.

Yoga and Meditation Cell
The College has established a Yoga and Meditation Centre to popularize the art of Yoga and
Meditation among the students in order to make this more fruitful. The college has organized
various programmes. The Cell has been tried to instrumentalization the activities for
popularizing Yoga among youth in the country.




Gender Sensitization and Sexual Harassment Prevention Cell:
The college is committed to create a safe environment for women students and employees. The
cell is actively involved in creation of awareness on the issue of sexual harassment by
conducting workshops and lectures by activists and academicians.
____________________________________________________
Golaghat Purbanchalik College Prospectus- 2025-2026                            Page.10
 Women Cell
Golaghat Purbanchalik College Women Cell is committed to promoting gender equality and
women's welfare through various activities and programs, such as Awareness Programs on
Gender Sensitization, Sexual Harassment, and Menstrual Hygiene, as well as Gender
Sensitization through Poster-Making Competitions, Yoga Programs for women. The Cell also
extends extension activities on Gender Equality, Prohibition of Child Marriage.




AWARDS AND REWARDS OF GOLAGHAT PURBANCHALIK COLLEGE
Best Graduate Award
The Best Graduate Awards have been instituted by IQAC/College to encourage the students to
involve themselves in their studies. The Best Graduate of each stream is selected on the basis of
the end semester results. These awards are comprised of a certificate of appreciation, a bunch of
books and felicitation, which are ceremonially presented to them on the foundation day of the
college.

Best Reader Award
The ‘Best Reader Award’ has been instituted by the college Central Library in consultation with
the IQAC. The ‘Best Reader’ of an academic year is selected on the basis of usage of library
books and study materials and result outcomes. This award is comprised of a certificate of
appreciation, a bunch of books and felicitation, which is ceremonially presented on the
foundation day of the college.
Educational Tours
 Academic departments of the college organize educational tours, field visit, and excursions to
different parts of Assam with the idea of exposing students to the culture, history, geography,
advanced research laboratories, libraries and national parks of the country.
PROGRAMMES OF STUDY
Four Year Undergraduate Programmes (FYUGP) Under NEP 2020 Golaghat Purbanchalik
College has implemented the Four Year Undergraduate Programme leading to Bachelor's degree
in Arts from the session 2023-24. The College is affiliated to Dibrugarh University and will
follow the Four Year Undergraduate Programme DU-FYUGP introduced by the University as
per the regulations of NEP 2020 and UGC.

ADMISSION FEES STRUCTURE
Golaghat Purbvanchalik College is a Provincialized College of Assam established in the year
1987 is presently offering B.A. (Hons. ) courses in Assamese, Economics, Education, Political
Science, History and Sociology as per curriculum of affiliation university (Dibrugarh
University). Hence, admission will be offered to the students for the four years B.A. (FYUGP)
and the fee structure will be decided accordingly as per rules of the Government of Assam.

IMPORTANT INFORMATIONS TO THE STUDENTS
IDENTITY CARD AND ACADEMIC CALENDAR
   • An identity card will be issued to every student after admission to the College. The card
      shall contain information of the holder along with a recent passport size photograph of
      the student duly endorsed by the Principal.
   • The Identity Card is non-transferable. A student must keep the Identity Card with
      him/her and he/she must produce the same whenever asked for.
   • Students must renew his/her Identity Card at the end of each academic year positively
   • Every student will be issued the Academic Calendar and the same has to be properly
       maintained by him/her. The records available in the Academic Calendar will be used for
      various official purposes concerning the student.

 EXAMINATION

      The College Examinations are held according to the College Academic Calendar for
      Degree classes. A student must appear in all the examinations conducted by the College
      during an academic year. The College follows the rules and regulations of Dibrugarh
      University in the Under Graduate (UG) Programme.
          • As such, a student's performance is strictly monitored through continuous basis,
             through assessment in the theory and practical courses. Internal assessment is

ANTI-RAGGING POLICY
In conformity with Supreme Court of India judgements and directions, UGC guidelines and State
Government Instructions, Golaghat Purbanchalik College is following ‘Zero-Tolerance Policy’
towards ragging. Any student of Golaghat Purbanchalik College accused and found guilty of
ragging, will be severely dealt with, in accordance with the Provisions of the Law.

Anti-Ragging Policy
According to the UGC Regulation on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Institutions,
2009, ragging constitutes one or more of any of the following acts:
____________________________________________________
Golaghat Purbanchalik College Prospectus- 2025-2026                                 Page.19
     Any conduct by any student or students whether by words spoken or written or by an act
which has the effect of teasing, treating or handling with rudeness a fresher or any other student.
   Indulging in rowdy or undisciplined activities by any student or students which causes or is
likely to cause annoyance, hardship, physical or psychological harm or to raise fear or
apprehension thereof in any fresher or any other student.
   Asking any student to do any act which such student will not in the ordinary course do and
which has the effect of causing or generating a sense of shame, or torment or embarrassment
so as to adversely affect the physique or psyche of such fresher or any other student.
   Any act by a senior student that prevents, disrupts or disturbs the regular academic activity of
any other student or a fresher.
   Exploiting the services of a fresher or any other student for completing the academic tasks
assigned to an individual or a group of students.
   Any act of financial extortion or forceful expenditure burden put on a fresher or any other
student by students.
   Any act of physical abuse including all variants of it: sexual abuse, homosexual assaults,
stripping, forcing obscene and lewd acts, gestures, causing bodily harm or any other danger to
health or person;
    Any act or abuse by spoken words, emails, post, public insults which would also include
deriving perverted pleasure, vicarious or sadistic thrill from actively or passively participating in
the discomfiture to fresher or any other student.
   Any act of physical or mental abuse (including bullying and exclusion) targeted at another
student (fresher or otherwise) on the ground of colour, race, religion, caste, ethnicity, gender
(including transgender), sexual orientation, appearance, nationality, regional origins, linguistic
identity, place of birth, place of residence or economic background.
Punishments
According to the UGC Regulation on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational
Institutions, 2009, depending on the nature and gravity of the guilt established by the Anti-
Ragging
Squad, those found guilty may be awarded one or more of the following punishments, namely;
   Warning , writing apology letter
   Suspension from attending classes and academic privileges.
   Withholding/ withdrawing scholarship/ fellowship and other benefits.
   Debarring from appearing in any test/ examination or other evaluation process.
   Withholding results.
   Debarring from representing the institution in any regional, national or international meet,
tournament, youth festival, etc.
   Suspension/ expulsion from the hostel.
   Cancellation of admission.
   Rustication from the institution for period ranging from one to four semesters.
   Expulsion from the institution and consequent debarring from admission to any other
institution for a specified period.

GENDER POLICY OF GOLAGHAT PURBANCHALIK COLLEGE
The Gender policy is integral part of all policies and programmes of Golaghat Purbanchalik
College. Gender equality and equity aims at ensuring both women and men including staff and
students are considered equal and treated equally in terms of dignity and rights. The atmosphere
in the college is such that there is not any kind of discrimination particularly based on sex. The
Gender policy provides guidelines and frameworks for promoting gender equality. To achieve
this target, the college has formed various cells like Women Cell, Students’ Grievance Redressal
Cell, Gender Sensitisation and Sexual Harassment Prevention Cell, Internal Complaint
Committee etc .The Gender Equity Policy in the college provides a framework of principles and
practices that will improve the opportunities to all the students regardless of whether they are
males or females. The Gender Equity Policy has been developed so that no students in the
college campus are disadvantaged on the basis of gender. The Indian constitution provides
equality before law for women under Article 14. The Article 15 prohibits discrimination on the
grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth. Framing a Gender policy is a commitment
towards our Indian Constitution. The overall effort is to promote gender equality within the
college and to strengthen the gender sensitivity among students and staff. The institution is
taking conscious and continuous efforts to maintain balanced and equal environment.
Key features of the Gender Policy of Golaghat Purbanchalik College
are:
1. Non-Discrimination: Golaghat Purbanchalik College is committed to upholding a strict policy
against all forms of gender-based discrimination, ensuring an environment that is fair and
inclusive for all individuals.
2. Equal Opportunities: We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for personal and
academic growth to individuals of all genders.
3. Freedom of Expression: We recognize and uphold the right of every individual, irrespective of
gender, to freely express their opinions and perspectives within our college community.
